speaker: tanya
text: Power's out on our whole block and it's ninety-seven degrees. Mrs. Alvarez on five needs her oxygen machine, and Mr. Chen's insulin is warming up. Darnell's got a generator, Priya's got a car. Help me.

speaker: village
text: Got it. A block outage in the heat, and two medical needs. Who on the block should I know about, and which floor are they on?

speaker: tanya
text: Mrs. Alvarez is on five in a walk-up. She's eighty-one, on home oxygen. The Okafors on three have a three-week-old. Mr. James on two is in a power wheelchair, and the elevator's out.

speaker: village
text: Who only has a landline? And where do people go to make calls?

speaker: tanya
text: Mrs. Alvarez only has her landline. Ramírez Deli on the corner has its own generator and ice. People call there.

speaker: tanya
text: Darnell's generator is a two-thousand-watt inverter, about six hours of fuel, outdoors only. Priya's car has A/C and fits three.

speaker: village
text: If someone can't breathe or passes out, what's the rule?

speaker: tanya
text: Nine one one first, then me. Nobody waits for me.

speaker: village
text: Here's the draft: five households, two volunteers, the deli as the phone point, and nine one one first. Anything wrong?
